content.title: Catastrophic Injury Lawyer in South Carolina | Free Consults
content.text: You can experience a catastrophic injury that makes it tough to enjoy your life to the fullest extent. The injury may have occurred through no fault of your own. Yet, you are still financially responsible for the costs of treating your injury. If you have suffered a catastrophic injury in South Carolina, now may be the time to reach out to a South Carolina personal injury lawyer at the Shelly Leeke Law Firm. We offer legal help to those dealing with catastrophic injuries caused by negligent parties. Our South Carolina catastrophic injury attorney can provide legal representation as you seek damages in a personal injury lawsuit. When an Injury Is Classified as “Catastrophic” A catastrophic injury can require lifelong medical treatment. Even if a person undergoes ongoing treatment for a catastrophic injury, there is no assurance that their health will improve. In many instances, a catastrophic injury affects a person’s cognition and ability to move. Catastrophic injuries come in many forms. Examples of catastrophic injuries include: Amputations Bone fractures Brain injuries Organ injuries Spinal cord injuries There are many reasons why people suffer catastrophic injuries. Common reasons for catastrophic injuries include car accidents, slips and falls, and workplace accidents. In some cases, a catastrophic injury occurs due to someone else’s negligence. The experienced attorneys at Shelly Leeke Law Firm are here to answer your questions and protect your legal rights. What to Do if You Experience a Catastrophic Injury Due to Negligence Do not accept that you must pay for all of the medical costs associated with your catastrophic injury. Instead, consider what caused your catastrophic injury to happen. If your injury was the result of a negligent party, you can seek damages. You can hire a South Carolina catastrophic injury lawyer who can file a lawsuit on your behalf. When you work with an attorney, you have a legal expert at your disposal. Thus, you are well equipped to seek compensation that you can use to cover any expenses relating to your injury. A catastrophic injury lawyer in South Carolina makes no guarantees. However, your attorney is your legal representative in a catastrophic injury lawsuit. Your lawyer can also answer any legal questions you have. South Carolina Catastrophic Injury Lawyer Near Me How to Choose the Right Catastrophic Injury Attorney in South Carolina Not all lawyers are created equal. If you want to file a catastrophic injury lawsuit in South Carolina, find an attorney with relevant experience. Then, your attorney can get you up to speed on what happens during a catastrophic injury lawsuit. You can meet with a catastrophic injury lawyer to find out what this legal professional has to offer. During your meeting, you can share your legal concerns. Plus, you can get insights into how the attorney will approach your lawsuit. As you pursue a catastrophic injury attorney, consider the lawyer’s reputation. The best catastrophic injury lawyer has received dozens of positive client testimonials. When you read these testimonials, you can get a glimpse into what it is like to partner with this attorney. We encourage you to reach out to us today for a complimentary, no obligation consultation. When to Expect Your South Carolina Catastrophic Injury Lawsuit to Get Resolved A catastrophic injury lawsuit is rarely an open-and-shut case. You may need months or years to resolve your lawsuit. In the meantime, your attorney will work with you to strengthen your argument. You and your lawyer can gather evidence that can be used during your trial. Evidence is the foundation of a successful lawsuit since it can be used to show a judge or jury what led to your catastrophic injury. If you have plenty of pertinent evidence, you should have no trouble presenting a compelling argument. Of course, your catastrophic injury lawsuit can be settled before your trial date. In this situation, a defendant can propose a settlement. If you accept the offer, you can forgo a trial. For more than a decade, the attorneys at the Shelly Leeke Law Firm have provided injury victims with the support and guidance. What to Do if You Are Presented with a South Carolina Catastrophic Injury Settlement If you get a South Carolina catastrophic injury settlement, it is in your best interest to consider it. You should not rush to accept the settlement, as doing so can cause you to make a poor decision. For those who are unsure of what to do with a settlement offer, consult with an attorney. A catastrophic injury lawyer can help you assess all aspects of a settlement proposal. The lawyer will encourage you to review an offer and consider what can happen if you accept it. Meanwhile, the attorney will not pressure you to make a quick decision about an offer. In the event that a settlement offer falls short of what you want, reject it. You will not be penalized if you decline a settlement proposal. Rather, you can continue to negotiate with a defendant or move forward with a trial. How to Achieve the Best Result During a South Carolina Catastrophic Injury Trial Partnering with a proven catastrophic injury lawyer in South Carolina is a must. Your lawyer can prepare you for your trial and make sure that you can avoid legal mistakes along the way. In addition, your attorney can put together an argument designed to convince a judge or jury to rule in your favor. Your attorney crafts a legal strategy that positions you for legal success. The strategy can include evidence and witness testimony that makes it clear to a judge or jury why you should be awarded the maximum amount of damages. Your lawyer will fine-tune your strategy leading up to your trial date, so you can present an argument that resonates with a judge or jury. Over the course of your trial, your attorney will dispute the defendant’s lawyer and any claims made against you. At the same time, your lawyer will help you share your side of the story regarding your catastrophic injury. The bottom line: once you hire a catastrophic injury lawyer, you can take the first step to win or settle your case. Get Started with a South Carolina Catastrophic Injury Attorney If you are ready to hire a South Carolina catastrophic injury lawyer, get in touch with the Shelly Leeke Law Firm. Our catastrophic injury attorney can review your legal claim and help you file a personal injury lawsuit right away. For more information or to request a consultation, please contact us today.
